records.observation: JFileChooser initialized from System.getProperty(user.dir) BEFORE storing appletflag; no security/headless exception handling. Title Select SLOG-2 file. Applet disables accept-all and explicitly setFileFilter(new LogRefuseDirFilter([slog2])). Nonapplet adds choosable LogPermitDirFilter([slog2,clog2,clog,rlog,txt]) only: does not explicitly setactivefilter ordisableacceptall here, effective UI defaults delegatedto JFileChooser. isTraversable applet returnsfalse null/directory, true for every non-directory File regardless extension/existence; nonapplet delegates superclass. This is UI filtering/traversal only, no path containment, file access policy, readable/isFile or SLOG2 header validation. Prior InputLog.isSLOG2 performs actual headerread when callersinvokeit; chooser doesnot. No archived GUI execution.

records.observation: Constructs separate String[] of sameinputlength, each newString(inputelement).trim; nullarray/element throws, no lowercase/leadingdot normalization, empties/duplicates accepted. Builds description once by concatenating space-star-dot+eachtrimmedextension plus and directories. Package-visible extns/description mutable; laterextensionchanges can leave description stale. accept(null) dereferences; isDirectory first returnstrue regardlessname. Otherwise extracts File.getName lastdot only if index>0 and beforelastchar; no dot, .slog2, trailingdot produce null; .hidden.slog2 extracts slog2. Extension lowercase uses defaultlocale then case-sensitiveequals against unchanged configuredextensions, so lowercase defaults work but custom uppercase entries fail for ordinary ASCII lowercasednames. Emptyextensionlist rejectsall nondirectories. No exists/isFile/canRead/content/magic validation: nonexistent filename matchingextension canpass ifnotdirectory. getDescription returns currentbuffer.toString, no fresh derivation. No archive execution.
